objects.description: During the [2026 U.S. Water Utilities Attacks](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0066), the adversary changed the IP addresses of internet-facing MicroLogix controllers, altering their network configuration settings outside normal operations.(Citation: Tenable Minnesota Water Utilities)(Citation: Forescout Water Systems Attack)(Citation: Dragos Water Under Attack)(Citation: FBI Water and Wastewater)
